meta.title: Barklog: Video Game Tracker – Organize Your Backlog
meta.description: Barklog is a video game backlog tracker for iPhone and iPad. Mark games Waiting, Playing, Completed or Abandoned, share a link to find a game, and start free with ten games.

hero.title: Every game you meant to get back to.
hero.subtitle: Keep track of what you're playing, what's waiting, what you finished and what you gave up on. No spreadsheet, no shame.
hero.free: Free for ten games. Premium is optional.

badge.label: Download Barklog on the App Store

share.title: Saw a game somewhere? Share it.
share.body: Spotted a game in a clip, a review or a store page and can't name it? Share the link to Barklog. It works out which game that is, hands you the matches, and you save the right one for later.
share.alt: Barklog after a link was shared to it: the shared video at the top and, under it, the games it might be, each with its cover and release year, ready to pick.

statuses.title: Four honest statuses
statuses.body: Most trackers assume you'll finish everything. Barklog doesn't. Abandoned is a real answer, and it's one tap away. Rate the games you've played, too.
statuses.alt: A game's page in Barklog: its cover, platforms, release date and summary above a control for setting the game's status and a rating.

explore.title: Find the next one
explore.body: See what's popular and what's coming soon, or look up a game by name. Tap one for its platforms, release date, summary and similar games.
explore.alt: Barklog's Explore tab: rows of game covers under headings for popular and upcoming games.

widgets.title: Your games, on your Home Screen
widgets.body: Add a widget for any status and tap a game to open it. Your Profile shows how many games sit in each status and your average rating.
widgets.alt: An iPhone Home Screen with Barklog widgets showing the covers of the games in progress.

pricing.title: Ten at a time, free
pricing.body: Barklog is free for ten unfinished games: the ones waiting, and the ones you're in the middle of. Finish one, or admit you're done with it, and the spot comes back.
pricing.cap: Premium takes the cap off, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial. That's the whole difference.

whatIs.a: Barklog is an iPhone and iPad app for keeping a video game backlog. Every game you add is Waiting, Playing, Completed or Abandoned, and you can rate the ones you've played.

free.a: Yes. You can keep up to ten Waiting or Playing games for free, and as many Completed and Abandoned games as you like.

premium.a: Barklog Premium removes the ten-game cap and nothing else. It's a monthly or yearly subscription through the App Store, and both start with a 7-day free trial.

android.a: No. Barklog runs on iPhone and iPad.

data.q: Where does the game information come from?
data.a: Every cover, release date, platform, genre and summary comes from IGDB, a games database its community maintains.

sharing.q: How does sharing a link work?
sharing.a: Share a link to a clip, review or store page from any app. Barklog reads the page's title, author and site and asks an AI model which game it's about; if that isn't enough, the model looks the link up on the web. Nothing about you is sent with it.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: Open the Profile tab, tap Delete Account and confirm. Your account and backlog are deleted right away. Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store subscription; cancel that in your Apple subscription settings.
